integrity: The calculations and mathematical proof are contained in the package. Independent review or validation has not been performed; computational examples are tests rather than proof in all dimensions.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the free associative tensor algebra truncated after degree two, with at least two generators; the geometric component count is for the reduced variety, not nonreduced scheme structure. No claim about truncation at higher degrees, exceptional one-generator cases, or classification of higher derivations. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Idempotent derivations of the free radical-cube-zero algebra: a characteristic-two orbit and rank census
